text: dsh-plugin-hot-reload 是供 DSH Web 使用的插件刷新扩展。它通过 Cordis bundle 接入 DSH，在查询时从磁盘读取插件清单、语言元数据和图标，并覆盖插件列表与浏览器模块的缓存解析结果。编辑其他插件的显示信息、移动已链接的插件目录或补充浏览器端模块后，刷新页面即可查看更新；无需重启 DSH。若修改本插件自身的入口代码或新增可导入的子路径，仍需重启。适合在本地开发和调整 DSH 插件时使用，按 README 安装到 Web profile。

dsh-plugin-hot-reload refreshes plugin metadata and browser modules in DSH Web. It reads manifests, locales, and icons from disk. Edit another plugin or move a linked package, then refresh the page to see changes without restarting DSH. Its own entry changes still require a restart.
想改完插件名称、简介或图标后，在 DSH 页面刷新就能看到变化。
DSH 的插件列表还显示旧的语言信息，能否直接重新读取磁盘内容？
How can I refresh plugin metadata and browser module discovery without restarting DSH?
dsh-plugin-hot-reload 的功能「实时读取插件展示信息」：查询插件时从磁盘读取 package.json、语言文件与图标，并更新插件元数据和 bundle 列表。修改其他插件的展示信息后刷新页面即可查看。
dsh-plugin-hot-reload 的功能「刷新浏览器模块解析」：定位插件清单并清除已缓存的解析结果，再标记模块并刷新浏览器模块注册表。移动链接插件或更改浏览器模块后，刷新页面即可应用。

dsh-plugin-hot-reload README · dsh-plugin-hot-reload：标题、简介、图标和浏览器模块都按磁盘现读现发布：改完立即生效，不用重启 DSH。

A DeepSeek Harness bundle. It replaces three cached resolvers with plain filesystem
walks, so a plugin's display metadata and browser module follow the package on disk
instead of a verdict cached for the life of the process:

dsh-plugin-hot-reload README · dsh-plugin-hot-reload：| Service | Why it is patched |
| --- | --- |
| `pluginPackages.metaOf` | The Host resolves `locale/*.json` and `icon.svg` through the Node ESM resolver. A package whose export was added after its first read stays bare until restart. |
| `pluginManager.listBundles` | The plugin inventory calls the Host reader directly, so it needs the same disk result even when the Host already produced a fallback. |
| `clientModules.resolveMeta` / `locatePkgJson` | Verdicts are cached in `pkgMeta`, `null` included. Moving a linked package makes its browser half disappear. |

dsh-plugin-hot-reload README · dsh-plugin-hot-reload：Install it into a profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add <path-to-this-checkout>
```

Editing another plugin's `locale/`, `icon.svg`, or manifest then needs only a page
refresh. Editing this plugin's own `index.js`, or adding a new importable subpath
export, still needs a restart: Node caches modules by URL.

dsh-plugin-hot-reload README · Test：```powershell
$env:DSH_RUNTIME = '<dsh-runtime>'
$env:DSH_PROFILE_DIR = '<profile-dir>'
node test/live.test.mjs
```

The check compares this reader against the Host reader for every package the profile
depends on, and reproduces the late-locale case.
